# Firebase JS SDK 13.4.0 (bundled)

Unmodified ES module builds of `firebase-app.js`, `firebase-auth.js` and `firebase-database.js` from
`https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/13.4.0/`, saved here so HuntLinq doesn't depend on a third-party CDN at startup.
Two edits only: the auth and database modules import `./firebase-app.js` instead of the gstatic URL, and the
`sourceMappingURL` comments are removed. To upgrade, download the same three files for the new version and repeat both edits.
